name: Standard Scramble

waypoints.name: Barlow Pass Trailhead
waypoints.note: From Granite Falls, Mountain Loop Highway east 31 miles to Barlow Pass; Weden Creek Trail to Gothic Basin for Del Campo Peak.
waypoints.directions: From Granite Falls, follow the Mountain Loop Highway east about 31 miles to Barlow Pass, where the pavement ends, and park at the trailhead lot at about 2,360 ft. A Northwest Forest Pass or Interagency pass is required.

waypoints.name: Gothic Basin
waypoints.directions: Walk the gated Monte Cristo road about a mile to the signed junction and turn right onto Gothic Basin Trail #724. It climbs steeply through timber, fords Weden Creek, and about 3 miles from the trailhead crosses a steep avalanche gully that can hold a firm snow tongue into July, then breaks out into the meadows and rock slabs of Gothic Basin near 5,000 ft.

waypoints.name: Foggy Lake
waypoints.directions: Follow the boot path across the basin past a small tarn and up boulder and talus slopes to Foggy Lake at about 5,200 ft, the last reliable water.

waypoints.name: Del Campo Peak Summit
waypoints.directions: Cross the boulder field on the climbers' trail along the lake's north side and climb Del Campo's south slopes to the snowfield below the summit wall near 6,200 ft. Avoid the obvious gully, which dead-ends at a vertical wall; take the blocky Class 3-4 ledges just left of it to the notch at about 6,350 ft, then turn left (west) for the short scramble to the summit.

descent_text: Reverse the ascent line: downclimb the class 3-4 rock left of the gully back to the ~6,350 ft col, then descend the blocky wall/rock slope back into the main gully system and down the south-facing slopes to Foggy Lake. This is a walk-off/downclimb scramble descent with no rappelling required — sources consistently describe it as reversing the ascent rather than a distinct technical descent line, though care is needed staying on the correct (looker's-left) rock rather than drifting into the steeper, wall-capped gully proper. Some parties note a narrow gully on the bluff above Foggy Pass (west of the true pass) that offers an alternate downclimb/traverse option back toward Foggy Lake if conditions or crowding make the standard line awkward. From Foggy Lake, retrace the boulder field and boot path back through Gothic Basin, re-cross the avalanche gully and Weden Creek, and descend Weden Creek (Gothic Basin) Trail #724 back to Barlow Pass. The descent through the upper talus/scree is notably slow and knee-jarring; snow lingering in the gully or basin can actually ease the descent (plunge-stepping/glissading) in early-to-mid season but adds slip hazard if icy.
